ms.report:
General Development﻿
You can access the GitHub link here. We have fulfilled the promised features and even expanded them with custom event implementation. Following the initial architecture draft, we made some adjustments to the underlying logic to improve the developer experience. As a result, the functions and naming might differ slightly, but the essential features are still present, just organized in a more user-friendly manner.
Additionally, we have officially integrated eight wallets, as you can see here. Developers can also interact with unsupported wallets, as we've included a feature that checks if a wallet adheres to the CIP-30 standard. If it does, the SDK will still support it.
Documentation Drafting
Currently, we've opted to use a single markdown file in the readme for documentation instead of Gitbooks, since Gitbooks is a paid feature tied to a user subscription model, which is not suitable for an open-source project. We may consider revising this approach in a future milestone if the documentation becomes too confusing or cumbersome.
